claim: Large Bandwidth Tunnels are available only for VPN connections attached to a transit gateway or to Cloud WAN, not for virtual private gateway attachments, and you can modify the tunnel bandwidth of existing VPN connections.

qualifiers.scope: Large Bandwidth Tunnels; VPN connections on a transit gateway or Cloud WAN

evidence.quote: You can modify the tunnel bandwidth of existing VPN connections.
Available only for VPN connections attached to a transit gateway or to Cloud WAN. Not supported for Virtual Private Gateway attachments.
